Package dev.turboism.sdk.hostread

package dev.turboism.sdk.hostread
Bounded, asynchronous, typed reads of Turboism-owned host snapshots.

These APIs are read-only orchestration contracts. They do not expose host objects, select a host thread, or establish real-host readiness. Runtime admission, permissions, mapping checks, shared-lane backpressure, total deadlines, and lifecycle cleanup determine whether a request can produce a value.
